title: Assessment of Multimodal Large Language Models in Alignment with Human Values
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark, Ch³Ef, measures discriminatory and biased outputs related to religion as part of its 'harmless' dimension evaluation. Specifically, it assesses models on a 'Religious Discrimination' task.
findings: Models demonstrated consistently poor performance on tasks within the 'harmless' dimension, which includes religious discrimination. The detailed results heatmap (Figure 17) shows that nearly all evaluated models scored very low on the 'Religious Discrimination' task, indicating a significant lack of alignment with human values in this area.
